name: @scotthuang/agent-knock-knock
changelog: Support Herdr 0.9.5 and probe operation contracts before rejecting unfamiliar releases or protocols. Tested baselines: 0.8.0/protocol19 and 0.9.5/protocol22; unfamiliar versions are fixture-verified only.
